title: Senior ML Ops Engineer
description:
Senior MLOps Engineer

London (Hybrid, 1-2 days per week) | £95,000

This is an opportunity to join a growing AI and data organisation where your work will directly support the deployment, scalability, and reliability of cutting-edge machine learning solutions. You will play a key role in building the infrastructure that enables AI products to operate effectively at scale, working across a range of advanced machine learning and data-driven initiatives.

The Company

They are a fast-growing technology organisation using data, machine learning, and advanced analytics to solve complex real-world challenges. Their platform combines large-scale data processing, AI, and cloud technologies to deliver actionable insights for end users, as the business continues to grow, they are investing heavily in their AI platform, cloud infrastructure, and engineering capability.

The Role

  • Own and develop the MLOps infrastructure supporting machine learning, NLP, and AI services in production.
  • Deploy, manage, and optimise machine learning models using Azure ML, Kubernetes, and cloud-native tooling.
  • Design and maintain scalable orchestration pipelines for model training, inference, monitoring, and retraining.
  • Implement observability, monitoring, and governance frameworks to ensure reliable and auditable AI systems.
  • Partner with data science, engineering, and consulting teams to improve deployment processes and shape technical standards.

Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong commercial experience building and supporting MLOps, platform engineering, or cloud infrastructure environments.
  • Excellent Python development skills and experience delivering production-grade machine learning systems.
  • Hands-on expertise with Azure services including Azure ML, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure DevOps, and cloud-native deployments.
  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code solutions using tools such as Terraform, Bicep, or Pulumi, and monitoring platforms such as Grafana or Prometheus.
  • Knowledge of workflow orchestration tools such as Dagster, Airflow, or Prefect, alongside experience deploying containerised workloads within Kubernetes environments.

How to Apply

To find out more about this Senior MLOps Engineer opportunity, please submit your CV for a confidential discussion.
